champions.desc: strongly leans Down near the top of the hourly range (pullbacks); leans Down when the futures premium is unusually high; has a time-of-day pattern; slightly leans Up during US stock market open; has a futures-funding-cycle pattern. Trusts the market price. Only bets during US market hours, only when the market is calm. Needs 2.7¢ of edge to bet.
champions.note: calibration shrank it almost to the market price (little real signal)
